pairs.source: Muscle cramps are a common problem characterized by a sudden, painful, involuntary contraction of muscle.
pairs.plain: Muscle cramps are a common problem represented by sudden, painful, involuntary muscle contractions.

pairs.source: Urinary incontinence is the inability to willingly control bladder voiding.
pairs.plain: Urinary incontinence is the inability to control your bladder.

pairs.source: Acute episodes of hyperkalemia commonly are triggered by the introduction of a medication affecting potassium homeostasis; illness or dehydration also can be triggers.
pairs.plain: Hyperkalemia that comes on rapidly is usually caused by an illness, dehydration, or by starting medicines that affect normal potassium balance in the body.

pairs.source: These changes provide an easier and more reliable means of diagnosing persons at risk of complications from hyperglycemia.
pairs.plain: These changes help improve identification of those at risk from effects of high blood sugar.
